body.description: Scootlet, a small living machine companion: a cute kick e-scooter creature with a single headlight eye, a stubby handlebar like ears, small deck body, two little wheels, restless like a puppy on wheels, scuffed teal and cream paint, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
